description: Get the original-language (German) text of one provision (§/Article/Annex) of an Austrian federal law, as of a given date. "law" accepts either a Gesetzesnummer (e.g. "10001622") or a title/abbreviation (e.g. "ABGB", "Datenschutzgesetz") — a title is resolved to its law number first. "paragraph" is the §/Art/Anlage number, e.g. "1328a". "as_of" (YYYY-MM-DD, default today) selects the Fassung (version) valid on that date; publication, in-force-from and in-force-until dates come back as separate fields, never folded together. Long provisions are paged via text_offset/text_has_more/text_next_offset, never silently truncated. Source: Bundeskanzleramt (Austria), Rechtsinformationssystem (RIS), Bundesrecht konsolidiert.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD — the version in force on this date (default: today).

text_offset.description: Character offset for paging long provision text (default 0).

name: at_get_provision
